title: 一年四次总统会晤：难题一两次谈不完，1月10日前能稳住吗？
speaker: Sean Stein

segments.en: So I think the tell is we've seen both sides talk about there will be four meetings between the presidents in this one year period, and what does that mean?
segments.zh: 我认为线索是，双方都提到这一年里两国领导人将有四次会晤，这意味着什么？

segments.en: It means both sides recognize there are really hard issues, and those really hard issues aren't going to get resolved in one meeting or two meetings, but they're going to have to have a steady consistent dialogue throughout the course of the year to really hopefully get beyond just stabilization to an air where they're making progress towards resolution.
segments.zh: 这意味着双方认识到存在非常棘手的问题，这些问题不会在一两次会晤中解决，而是需要全年持续稳定的对话，希望能超越仅仅稳定，进入朝着解决取得进展的阶段。

segments.en: And so I think the positive scenario is we have a very good summit tomorrow. The two sides start to build trust. They start to create mechanisms to have more regular dialogue that gets built on up in APEC and it gets built on again in a DORAL in the margins of the G20.
segments.zh: 所以我认为积极情景是明天峰会非常顺利，双方开始建立信任，开始创建更定期对话的机制，并在APEC和G20场边继续推进。

segments.en: So the better scenario is the between now and January 10th we have stability, and we're on a path to where we can start resolving some of these issues.
segments.zh: 更好的情景是，从现在到1月10日保持稳定，并走上开始解决其中一些问题的道路。
